utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I could use a hand clearing out some overgrown bushes in the back—think anyone from the drive might have time for that?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, definitely, maybe once we sort out that pump, we can rally a few folks to tackle those bushes too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's really kind, Dane—thanks! By the way, what's the pump situation? Is it giving everyone trouble?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Opal, just confirming our repair drive plans—I've got my toolbox ready and the lemonade prepped!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara! I've got the list of houses mapped out—let's start with the Andersons' place on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds like a plan! I'll load up the toolbox and meet you at the Andersons'.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Noah, I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, even a soldering iron if you need it. Just say the word and I'll bring 'em over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right! The repair drive. That's really kind of you, Gus. Let me check my calendar and get back to you on the day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Take your time, Noah. Just let me know when and I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The 15th? That rings a bell, but I can't quite place it. Let me check my notes real quick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Saturday the 15th! That's the date we settled on for the repair drive — I've already told Cleo about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday the 15th, right! I think I wrote that down somewhere... or maybe I dreamt it. Either way, I'm in!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have some spare parts in my garage. Want me to check what I have that might be useful?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, really? You've got spare parts just lying around? I mean, that'd be great, but I'm still not sure this whole drive thing is real.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's real all right! I've been stockpiling bits and bobs for years. Let me pop out to the garage and see what I've got for Vik's toaster.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? I'm getting everyone together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'll be there! Rey gave me some flyers to hand out while I shop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, glad to hear it! I'll let you know if anyone else signs up while you're spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I've got a hammer and some spare wood. Show me which fence panels need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Leo, but have you checked if the parts are properly sorted? I'd hate for us to run out halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good point. I'll check the supply first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, Hana! I'm gathering people who can fix bikes and small appliances—do you know anyone handy who might want to join?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Jules—are you talking about the same repair drive for the community center's water pump, or is this a different project for bikes and appliances?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, good point! It's actually a whole neighborhood repair drive—bikes, appliances, and yeah, if someone can help with the community center's pump, that'd be amazing too!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Leo! Let me know if you can bring any tools or supplies, and we can set a time to tackle those repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'd be happy to help with the repair drive too, Rosa. Maybe I can sort through some of the donated electronics.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Rey! Sorting electronics will be a huge help. Can you come by the community center on Saturday morning to get started?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I hope they get enough parts too. Are you planning to go, Uli?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might come by for a bit, if things work out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great! I think it'll be fun, and maybe we can grab a coffee afterward if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, when's the repair drive actually starting? I've got a broken fence post that's been waiting weeks.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right after lunch, Mina. I've got a list to check with Gus first—best to keep things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I'll be there after lunch. Do I need to bring my own tools or will you have some?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So it's free repairs for broken items. I might come by if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That'd be great, Bo! We'll take all the help we can get — just let me know if you need me to swing by and grab anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam. I'll keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Kira, I'm so glad I ran into you! The repair drive is this Saturday, and I'm spreading the word to get everyone to bring their broken stuff. Want to join in?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? I'm a bit confused — I thought Sam mentioned a clean-up. Are we fixing things this Saturday or cleaning up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, no, Kira, the clean-up is next weekend! This Saturday is all about fixing stuff — think of it as a chance to bring your broken toaster or that wobbly chair and get it sorted with help from the neighbors!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping Rey pass out flyers if you want to get involved.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, yes I know about the repair drive this Saturday! I'm bringing my old toaster, and Cleo is checking her garage for spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, Cleo's always got a knack for finding useful stuff. Are you heading over to grab a flyer from me while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let me grab that list from my pocket—I've got it all written down neat and tidy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, perfect. I'd love to see what's on that list, maybe I can help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Here it is—I've got it organized by what's needed most, so we can tackle the important repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, so you're saying the pump's been acting up? I thought it was just me noticing it—has anyone called the repair crew yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, not yet—but the repair drive is this weekend, so maybe we can add it to the list of things for the volunteers to look at.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, I'd like to double-check what specific parts or tools they'll bring—no point adding it if they can't fix that kind of pump.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Bo, I heard about the repair drive from Mina—are you involved too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I just heard about it in passing. Sounds like a good idea, but I'm too swamped to help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's too bad you're swamped—I'm hoping to get some yard help myself, but I'm still figuring out who's organizing what.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, great to see you! I'm rallying neighbors for that repair drive — you got any handy skills to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Jules! Yeah, I'm in—I'm pretty good with wrenches and pipe fittings, so count me in for the pump fix.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Dane! Opal's already got a house list going — I'll add you to the crew for that pump job and see what else needs wrenching.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey, Pia. Sorry, I spaced out—what were we saying about the repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was just wondering if they have enough tools and parts for everyone who shows up this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the drive. Yeah, I think Gus offered to bring his toolbox, so that should help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, 123 Maple Street is on the list. I'll mark it down and we can check the next address.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. What's next?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let me pull up my list... I think next is the blue house on Elm, number 45. Can you confirm that one?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to make it, but I've got some things to take care of.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Uli. If you need a hand with those things before the drive, just holler.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate that, but I'll manage.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, Mina, I was just talking to Pia about that—she's worried about parts, but I think if enough folks chip in, it'll be fine!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Tess, has anyone actually set a date for this drive? I'm still waiting on that fence post.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard it's supposed to be this weekend, but you know how these things are—might want to check with Jerry at the hardware store for the exact date!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Saturday! I think I wrote that down somewhere... or maybe it was next Saturday? I'm glad you're keeping track, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, I’ll pop into my garage and dig through the bins—I’m sure I’ve got a few switches and wires that might help fix that toaster of yours, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, my toaster! Right, it's been acting up. Switches and wires, you say? I hope I can remember where I put the darn thing...

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard about the repair drive—I've got my toolbox ready if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Gus, that's awesome! I was just about to ask if you could help out—we're meeting at the school parking lot on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll be there with my toolbox. Count me in!

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
